# Let me try clicking on the red block at top-left
# First, let me find the red block's position
seg = current_frame.segmentation
red_block = None
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'R':
        red_block = n
        break

if red_block:
    b = red_block['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    rr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
    rc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
    print(f"Red block: row={rr}, col={rc}, pixels={red_block['pixels']}")
    
    # Try clicking on the red block
    print(f"\nClicking on red block at row={int(rr)}, col={int(rc)}:")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': int(rr), 'col': int(rc)}])
    
    # Check if anything changed
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
            pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
            print(f"Player after click: row={pr}, col={pc}")
            break
    
    yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
    print(f"Bird count: {len(yellow_birds)}")
    print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    print(f"Board changed: {last_action_result.get('board_changed')}")

else:
    print("No red block found")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
